headline: The future of Paris's Tour Montparnasse hangs in the balance as co-owners feud
description: With just three months to go before the building permit for the transformation of the Paris skyscraper expires, a series of unexpected twists has shaken the project launched a decade ago. In July, Paris Mayor Emmanuel Grégoire urged the co-owners to settle their disputes. Le Monde takes a look behind the scenes at the ongoing negotiations.

headline: The Suez Canal: Birth and death of a colonial myth
description: 'Suez, a historic canal' (1/6). In 1869, the creation of a maritime route linking the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea, operated by the French and the British, captivated Europe. Initially a symbol of colonial oppression for the Egyptian people, the waterway became a tool of emancipation when President Nasser announced its nationalization 70 years ago, on July 26, 1956.
